'''G4-0M''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. G4 served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a courier on [[Carrick Station]], delivering messages and mission briefings from the [[Republic Emergency Response Corps|Emergency Response Corps]] to Republic personnel aboard.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
G4-0M serves as the Republic Flashpoint Courier for the flashpoint [[Cademimu uprising|"Cademimu Uprising"]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
